recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add a standard NutritionProduct biological-source-event search parameter unless the work group explicitly supersedes FHIR-47242; projects needing that search can define their own parameter as FHIR-47242 states.
issue_request: FHIR-34421 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request for R5 asking to make the new biologicalSource element a search parameter on BiologicallyDerivedProduct, Device, and NutritionProduct, and to remove the old distinctIdentifier-to-RIM-lotNumber mapping concern associated with the same biological-source concept.
initial_application: Commit 4b23eaac39 initially added biologicalSource search parameters to all three resources; commits 5bcd0301a3 and f231fc0832 corrected the NutritionProduct expression/code. Commit 2eea560fe4 for FHIR-35968 removed BiologicallyDerivedProduct.distinctIdentifier and its RIM lotNumberText mapping. Later FHIR-37199 renamed biologicalSource to biologicalSourceEvent across the affected resource definitions.
additional_context: The three resources are active in source/fhir.ini. Current source has active biological-source-event search parameters for BiologicallyDerivedProduct.biologicalSourceEvent and Device.biologicalSourceEvent. NutritionProduct still has NutritionProduct.instance.biologicalSourceEvent as an element, but FHIR-47242 specifically considered instance.biologicalSourceEvent as a proposed NutritionProduct search parameter and decided not to make it a standard search parameter because projects can add it locally when needed. Later NutritionProduct traceability work continues to rely on the element itself, not a required standard search parameter.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Re-adding a NutritionProduct biological-source-event search parameter would conflict with FHIR-47242, while BiologicallyDerivedProduct and Device already carry the renamed search parameter and the obsolete distinctIdentifier/RIM mapping is not present on current biologicalSourceEvent elements.
